prevention_rules: Never present page views, client form intent, or robot traffic as independently verified people, leads, or orders.
Missing source/readback is UNAVAILABLE and truncated result is TRUNCATED, never a zero or green status.
Customer and admin experiment data must be tenant-scoped; owner-only global queries use existing Netlify Identity admin allowlist.
The only browser-to-commercial event path is consent-gated and uses the already durable canonical queue with bounded retries using the same event_id.
Do not delete raw telemetry from a local batch before a persisted ACK. Historic raw telemetry remains unverified until issue #5141 closes.
Never add a scheduler, fallback publisher, third-party tracker, raw form values or browser fingerprint to fill measurement gaps.
A material change must update the Brain learning record, activity ledger and human change documentation, and require protected tests and production readback.
